summary_rationale: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. is the undisputed global scale leader in outsourced semiconductor assembly and test (~27-28% OSAT market share) and operates a complementary System-in-Package and EMS arm via Universal Scientific Industrial (USI). In 2025-2026, the business is undergoing a powerful structural mix upgrade: its Leading-Edge Advanced Packaging (LEAP) revenue scaled from ~$1.6 billion in FY2025 toward >$4.0 billion in FY2026, propelling Q3 2026 consolidated revenue up 44.8% YoY to NT$244.2 billion and lifting ATM gross margins above the historical 25% ceiling to 30.6%. However, ASE remains a capital-intensive, cyclical manufacturing business tethered to semiconductor inventory cycles, a structurally lower-margin EMS division (~9.1% gross margin, ~2.9% operating margin in FY2025), and an unprecedented capital expenditure surge (NT$162.1 billion in FY2025; US$11.5 billion guided for FY2026) that turned free cash flow negative in FY2025 (-NT$19.9 billion) and requires sustained AI/HPC utilization to earn above its cost of capital. Accordingly, ASE earns a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL quality rating with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health.
